weak.note: Devin (SWE-2): easy items only, under the easy rule. Its builds check themselves before any review.

medium.note: Meta through Muse: the most reliable builder (#305), first among the medium models.
Claude Sonnet at xhigh (#317 part 5): a medium seat on every Claude account, which switches between it and Opus as the work needs (work.Worker._switch).

strong.note: Claude Opus, on every Claude account, beside its Sonnet.

claude-1.note: The Claude subscription the bot has always used; shared with its owner and bright-bots-harness. Second in the usage order: Opus for strong roles, Sonnet (medium) for easy and medium builds, and each run switches between the two as the work needs. Two lanes, so it works two items at once.

claude-2.note: A second Claude account, capped at 90% of both its 5-hour session and its week. Kept back for planning and adversarial review on Opus: after the medium models in the usage order, and it builds only when no other subscription that may is free, Devin included (build_last), on Sonnet unless the item is hard; its runs switch between the two as the work needs. Two lanes, so it works two items at once.

claude-3.note: A third Claude account, the bot's own: any hour, no caps. First in the usage order: Opus for strong roles, Sonnet (medium) for easy and medium builds, and each run switches between the two as the work needs. Two lanes, so it works two items at once.

claude-4.note: A fourth Claude account (token added 2026-10-04) with no weekly cap: any hour under 50% of its 5-hour session (off_hours), and from 03:00 to 15:00 Central (its window) up to 70% of it. Opus for strong roles, Sonnet (medium) for easy and medium builds, and each run switches between the two as the work needs.

claude-5.note: A fifth Claude account (token added 2026-10-04): any hour, capped at 40% of its 5-hour session and 60% of its week. Opus for strong roles, Sonnet (medium) for easy and medium builds, and each run switches between the two as the work needs.

claude-6.note: A sixth Claude account (token added 2026-10-05), same rules as claude-4 with no weekly cap: any hour under 50% of its 5-hour session (off_hours), and from 03:00 to 15:00 Central (its window) up to 70% of it. Opus for strong roles, Sonnet (medium) for easy and medium builds, and each run switches between the two as the work needs.

claude-7.note: A seventh Claude account (token added 2026-10-07), under the same rules as claude-3: any hour, no caps (its whole 5-hour session, no weekly cap). Second in the usage order, after claude-3: Opus for strong roles, Sonnet (medium) for easy and medium builds, and each run switches between the two as the work needs.

gpt.note: ChatGPT through the Codex CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-gpt (`codex login`).

agy.note: Google's Antigravity CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-agy. Gemini 3.8 Flash (High); `agy models` lists the names, each carrying its effort. Its usage is its own `agy -p /usage` (no model call), the Gemini pool's row: read before the run, after every call and every ten minutes during one.

devin.note: Cognition's Devin CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-devin (`devin auth login --force-manual-token-flow`). SWE-2, its effort in the name; `devin models list` names the models. Weak, so it builds easy items only, and it takes them ahead of the stronger models while it has a free lane (easy_first). Off from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-06 (#311): every call failed within seconds from 07:30Z; back on once a `devin -p` call answered on the machine again (#318).
devin.off_reason: SWE-2 is free on Devin's CLI only through 2026-10-16 (devin.ai/pricing). After that it draws on the Devin plan's daily and weekly allowance, at 6x (medium) to 12x (max) credits, so Devin needs a new model, caps, or to stay off.

muse.note: Meta's Muse Code CLI, logged in on the machine as agent-muse (`muse login`). Its usage is the TUI's `/usage` panel (`muse exec` runs no slash commands), read before the run, after every call and every ten minutes during one. Four lanes, `night-vm-muse` and `night-vm-muse-2` to `night-vm-muse-4`, under the one login; `bot/machine/register-runners.sh` registers one runner per lane.
